applicant.name: Dr. Katja Berger
applicant.organisation: University Department of Psychiatry, epidemiology unit

purpose: Research on the incidence of depression and obesity to plan outpatient services.
question: How many people were newly diagnosed with depression in 2024 and how many with obesity, in each hospital?
definitions: A new diagnosis in 2024 is a diagnosis whose onset date lies in 2024.
Depression = ICD-10 starting with F32. Obesity = ICD-10 starting with E66.
Hospital = data holder of the patient record.
Per hospital: patients with a depression onset in 2024 and patients with an obesity onset in 2024.
